mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_snapshot(user_id,username,real_name,enabled,source_version) VALUES(#{userId},#{username},#{realName},#{enabled},#{authVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username=IF(VALUES(source_version)>=source_version,VALUES(username),username), real_name=IF(VALUES(source_version)>=source_version,VALUES(real_name),real_name), enabled=IF(VALUES(source_version)>=source_version,VALUES(enabled),enabled), source_version=GREATEST(source_version,VALUES(source_version))
